name: NumberBox
description: Numeric input with optional min/max/step constraints, label, helper text, and error display.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with valueAsNumber on every change

snippets.webcomponent:
<cl-numberbox label="Quantity" min="1" max="99" step="1"></cl-numberbox>

<script>
  document.querySelector('cl-numberbox').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
    console.log('value:', e.detail);
  });
</script>
